name: Hall of Arms (Tyr's Hand)
summary: Scarlet fighters hold the Hall of Arms in Tyr's Hand, deep in the southeastern Plaguelands. This wing of Tyr's Hand Abbey houses the crusade's martial vanguard, across the abbey from its library.

sections.title: A Bastion of Steel
sections.body: Scarlet fighters keep watch in the Hall of Arms, south of Tyr's Hand Abbey's main hall. Their armory and quarters fill this wing, while archives and holy texts are kept opposite. The defenders wear heavy armor and swear to destroy the undead and anyone they judge impure. As horrors surround them in the Plaguelands, they guard the abbey and keep their weapons and shields ready.

faq.q: Where is the Hall of Arms located?
aliases: tyrs hand abbey hall of arms
faq.answer: The Hall of Arms lies within Tyr's Hand Abbey, in Tyr's Hand in the southeastern Eastern Plaguelands. It forms the abbey's southern wing, opposite the Library Wing.

faq.q: Who occupies the Hall of Arms?
aliases: who lives in hall of arms
faq.answer: Elite Scarlet Crusade fighters hold the Hall of Arms. Warriors, paladins, and guards tend their weapons there and prepare to fight the Scourge and outsiders who enter their sanctuary.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this wing compared to the rest of the abbey?
aliases: what is hall of arms for
faq.answer: The Hall of Arms houses troops, weapons, and the work of keeping both ready for battle. Across the abbey, the opposite wing is devoted to study, contemplation, and scripture. Here, the defenders prepare against Scourge attacks.

faq.q: Can members of the Alliance enter peacefully?
aliases: is scarlet crusade friendly to alliance
can alliance visit hall of arms
faq.answer: No. The Scarlet Crusade in Tyr's Hand attacks Alliance and Horde travelers on sight. Though they share human roots and venerate the Holy Light, they see outsiders as possible plague carriers or allies of evil.

angles.text: For a knight of the Silver Hand, the Hall of Arms is a bitter sight: sacred traditions of holy combat turned toward zealous isolation.
The Hall of Arms shows human arms and disciplined preparation for battle at their peak. Yet fanaticism directs their use.
